deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.intro: You will be signed out immediately. Your account will be deleted after a 3-day (72-hour) waiting period.
deletion.item1: Once deletion takes effect, your profile, financial records, assets, budgets, and community content will be cleared and cannot be recovered.
deletion.item2: Once deletion takes effect, you will no longer be able to sign in to or use this account.
deletion.item3: To keep your data, sign in before the waiting period ends to cancel deletion.
deletion.acknowledge: I understand that cleared data cannot be recovered
deletion.codePlaceholder: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your current email
